review.headline: Long run completed at 18.6 km, steady and within the easy band.
observations: Ran 18.6 km at 5:52/km average, inside the 5:11-6:13/km easy target, with every full km split at 5:52.
Average HR 146 (max 149) was steady and controlled, slightly above the prior 17 km long run (5:50/km, 143 bpm).
Efficiency of 1.169 is the lowest of the recent easy and long runs, consistent with higher HR at a similar pace over the longer distance.
flags: Average HR 146 is above the 4-week easy average of 141; keep an eye on accumulating fatigue.
No RPE or athlete note was logged, so the subjective effort of this run is unknown.
Efficiency has trended down across the last two long runs (1.200 to 1.169).
